limits: README extrema disagree with unchanged source stress/deformation images. Retain both; do not average them or silently replace a revision.
README says STEP, drawings and a complete report are included, but pinned tree has native SLDPRT/SLDASM, five FEM images and a bare WBPJ only. No neutral STEP, SLDDRW, PDF report, MECHDB or RST.
Compatible native import and assembly dependency/pose verification are pending. Seven part definitions and one assembly remain one geometry family.
Eight bonded regions describe an idealized static assembly, not frictional thread engagement, rotation, lifting cycles or buckling capacity.
Displayed safety factor is a capped Stress Tool display; do not turn a >10 or 15 display cap into an exact certified safety margin.
